verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents the *consumer* side of HTTP 402 machine payments: a Crossmint wallet automatically reads 402 payment terms, signs a stablecoin payment, and retries the request without any checkout UI (x402 and MPP flows). This proves agents can pay per-call machine payments seamlessly, but the evidence never describes the *developer/merchant* side — how to gate your own API behind a 402 response and receive/settle Crossmint-paid calls as a monetization mechanism. Missing for 10: server-side guide for protecting/monetizing an API with 402, facilitator/verification tooling for the receiving merchant, and pricing/fees for API monetization via x402.
